turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and when?
I don't think this is productive.
Productive. My son found out from his phone, in class. Answer the question.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, and I'm not leaving. You entered a zero without calling me first, so either you tell me what you have, or I'm in the principal's office before your bell.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I won't be emailing; I'll be walking down that hall. One question before you go: is there anything on Owen's record right now?
